opportunities.title: Disconnected communication needs explicit delivery layers
opportunities.dated_artifact: RFC 9171 BPv7 January 2022; RFC 9713 January 2025 update; ION current branch inspected 2026-09-28
opportunities.evidence: BPv7 defines store-carry-forward bundles, expiry and status reports. NASA/JPL ION offers an implementation; its broader module list does not qualify every deployment.
